storylines.title: How To Watch And Live Stream Indiana Pacers vs Philadelphia 76ers NBA Game Tonight: TV Channels, Team News, Start Time
storylines.summary: Game Details Date Wednesday, October 28 Start Time 7 PM ET / 6 PM CT / 4 PM PT Location Gainbridge Fieldhouse, Indianopolis How to Watch on TV Fans have national and regional broadcasting options for tonight's game: National Broadcast ESPN/ESPN DEPORTES Indiana Home Broadcast - Philadelphia Away Broadcast NBC Sports Philadelphia How to Live Stream If you are looking to stream the game live, you have a few digital platforms available depending on your location: Pacers fans in local market DAZN 76ers fans in local market Peacock Out-of-market fans NBA League Pass READ MORE : Full List Of NBA Regional Sports Networks Team News & What to Watch For This is an Eastern Conference clash. Indiana Pacers: The Pacers are an even 2-2 and lost their last game by a score of 110-102 on the road against the Bucks Monday night. Pascal Siakam is averaging 23.5 points per game, but the participation of rebounds leader Ivica Zubac is doubtful considering an ankle injury. Philadelphia 76ers: The 76ers are 3-1 and currently second in the Eastern Conference following a 100-106 road win at the home of the NBA champion New York Knicks. Tyrese Maxey is currently in top form averaging 28.8 points per game.
